newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live and dressed basis Tuesday were mostly $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said. Demand and seller interest was uneven. Some buyers lowered their bids after the noon hour, when both CME and boxed beef prices moved sharply lower. Confirmed - 15,400 Last Week - 71,800 Last Year - 92,000
Wk To Date- 20,300 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 85,400 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 101,700

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1325 lbs - 65.00-66.00 ( weighted average 65.20 ); dressed basis mostly 106.00, few to 105.00, couple pens 106.50, ( weighted average 105.99). Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1225 lbs - few loads 65.00-65.50 ( weighted average 65.33 ); dressed basis 106.00, few 105.00, ( weighted average 105.92).
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
